stem: Which sentence from the selection is best supported by the photographs?

options.label: A
options.text: Shapes of bears, wolves, whales, eagles, and other wild creatures were carved into soft tree trunks.

options.label: B
options.text: Once a stone adze (an ax-like tool) brought down an 80-foot giant.

options.label: C
options.text: Thick bark is stripped away; then knots, once burned with hot rocks, are sanded smooth.

options.label: D
options.text: Drums and voices swelled like thunder when the pole rose.
